episodeTitle.en: Why great AI products are all about the data | Shaun Clowes (CPO at Confluent)
episodeTitle.zh: 优秀的AI产品为何都离不开数据 | 肖恩·克洛斯（Confluent首席产品官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Shaun Clowes is the chief product officer at Confluent and former CPO at Salesforce’s MuleSoft and at Metromile. He was also the first head of growth at Atlassian, where he led product for Jira Agile and built the first-ever B2B growth team. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why most PMs are bad, and how to fix this
guestBioOfficial.zh: 肖恩·克洛斯（Shaun Clowes）是Confluent的首席产品官，曾任Salesforce旗下MuleSoft和Metromile的首席产品官。他还是Atlassian首位增长业务负责人，负责Jira Agile产品并组建了首个B2B增长团队。在我们的对话中，我们探讨了：•为何大多数产品经理表现不佳，以及如何改善这一现状

title.en: Why great AI products are all about the data | Shaun Clowes (CPO at Confluent)
title.zh: 优秀的AI产品为何都离不开数据 | 肖恩·克洛斯（Confluent首席产品官）

summary.en: Shaun combines tactical execution with strategic framing, sharing lessons from building retention/engagement and data-for-PMs courses and leading product at multiple enterprises. He discusses how to think about retention and engagement as systems, the role of data in product decisions, and how to operate effectively as a CPO across very different company stages. The episode is packed with frameworks for product leaders scaling complex B2B businesses.
summary.zh: Shaun 将战术执行与战略框架相结合，分享了他在打造“留存/参与”与“面向 PM 的数据”课程、并在多家企业领导产品中的经验。他讨论了如何将留存与参与视为系统、数据在产品决策中的作用，以及作为 CPO 如何在不同阶段的公司中有效运作。本期为正在规模化复杂 B2B 业务的产品领导者，提供了满满的框架。
